rules: Actual native Popen delegates the same current Root policy in the relay,not a queued grant. Fixed adapter import plus source manifest is derived only from a trusted prepared controller binding and inherited private descriptor; model payload has no module/source selection.

Parent retains native stdin. Canonical single-object JSON is staged without its final closing brace. Final brace+delimiter is a nonblocking bounded effect under current authority; partial/unknown commits quarantine and never resend.
All relay forwarding and diagnostics are nonblocking/bounded. Preserve existing totals,deadline/controller-loss TERM/KILL and all historical stopped-relay limits.
Raw transport fixtures grant no Core task authority. Every managed factory/producer requires typed actual invocation capabilities. Account/model/provider operations remain excluded.

Protected merge stays a separately accounted authority/lifecycle; no foreground script rewrite or small native-model deadline imposed on its process. Unconfigured live merge authority refuses rather than substitutes a flow.
runtime_gate: Standing user authorization covers own-reviewed finite local mechanical batches only. Freeze actual source/command/resources and preserve every attempted outcome; no actual native accounts/models/providers or normal activation.
